_note: Song forms (docs/song-engine-v2-prd.md R7): the running order of a song, as section ids from data/song-section-templates.json. A section that plays more than once reuses its material; `variation` names a controlled change from `variations` (the only difference verify allows between repeats). `default` is the form the Generator shows (owner call, 2026-09-30: Standard with an ending, once the form layout was picked).

push.label: adds a push
push._note: The next chord arrives an eighth early at the first chord change after bar 1 (where the section has no push already).

double.label: played twice
double._note: The whole section plays twice in a row.
